name: Big Brother
description: Camera channels with screen feeds. One camera per channel, unlimited screens. Click a camera to swing its capture corner; screens draw the live feed with a per-channel border.
author: MickeyDisn

isEnabled.descriptionKey: Turn the mod on or off without unsubscribing.

channels.descriptionKey: Number of camera channels (1-10). Each channel gets one camera and one screen type.

zoneTiles.descriptionKey: How many tiles the camera captures in each direction (2-12).
